plugins.name: awow
plugins.description: Bring the Agentic Way of Working to any repo. /setup-awow walks you through connecting your issue board and your team's conventions, and the delivery commands then keep the board current as a byproduct of the work — without changing anything you've already built.

plugins.name: awow-workflows
plugins.description: The optional workflow bundle for awow: design and planning, meetings and retros, digests, strategy and OKRs, knowledge capture, and styled documents. Installs beside awow; self-contained, and expects a repo configured by awow's /setup-awow.

plugins.name: awow-telemetry
plugins.description: The evidence layer for awow. Export your agent sessions, build a visual timeline of how a project actually got built, score prompt craft, and coach a team or an individual off what the sessions show. Installs beside awow; neither requires the other.
